# Unstyled UI components for building accessible user interfaces
From the creators of Radix, Floating UI, and Material UI, Base UI is a comprehensive UI component library for building accessible user interfaces with React.

Base UI is built to last.

## The fine print
### What is Base UI?
Base UI components are highly configurable, composable, and customizable.

web.title: Top Headless UI libraries for React in 2026 | Blog - GreatFrontEnd
web.description:
# Top Headless UI libraries for React in 2026
1. **Radix UI was acquired by WorkOS** and updates have slowed for some components. **Base UI** (maintained by MUI) is now the more actively maintained primitive layer.
2. **shadcn/ui has become the most common way teams consume Radix or Base UI primitives** in production. It isn't strictly headless since it ships with Tailwind styles, but we cover it at the end since it sits on top of the headless layer.

## Understanding the layers [Copy heading URL](https://www.greatfrontend.com/blog/top-headless-ui-libraries-for-react-in-2026#understanding-the-layers)
- **Primitive layer**: accessible, unstyled, low-level components you compose into your own UI. Examples: Radix UI, Base UI, React Aria, Aria Kit.

## Headless UI [Copy heading URL](https://www.greatfrontend.com/blog/top-headless-ui-libraries-for-react-in-2026#headless-ui)
It's a small set of unstyled, accessible components designed to compose with Tailwind utilities.

## shadcn/ui (the dominant consumer of headless primitives) [Copy heading URL](https://www.greatfrontend.com/blog/top-headless-ui-libraries-for-react-in-2026#shadcnui-the-dominant-consumer-of-headless-primitives)
The components are built on Radix UI primitives by default (with Base UI as an opt-in alternative since 2025) and styled with Tailwind CSS.

web.title: Top 10 React UI Libraries for 2026 | Supernova.io
web.description:
# Top 10 React UI Libraries for 2026
## Share
This guide covers the React UI libraries worth knowing in 2026: what each one is, who it suits, and where it stands now that headless primitives, Tailwind CSS v4 and React 19 have reset the defaults.

## 2. [Base UI](https://base-ui.com/)
**Base UI** is an unstyled, headless component library from the creators of [Radix](https://www.radix-ui.com/), [Floating UI](https://floating-ui.com/) and [Material UI](https://mui.com/).

## 4. [Material UI (MUI)](https://mui.com/)
The same company now also ships Base UI, which is where its unstyled-primitive work has gone.

## How to choose a React UI library in 2026
- **Styled or headless:** building your own look on accessible primitives? Base UI or Radix. Want styled components ready to theme? MUI, Chakra, Mantine, Ant Design or HeroUI.

| Library | Type | Best for |
|-|-|-|
| Base UI | Headless primitives | New design systems, active maintenance |

The libraries are converging on the same foundations: Tailwind v4, React 19, CSS-based styling and accessible primitives.
